description: Land Acquisition - Bendiwewa & Kaduruwela Villages, Thamankaduwa  D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their boundaries, extents, and adjacent properties. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
